| State | Signers |

| Pennsylvania | John Harris, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Miller, George Ross, James Smith |
| New Jersey | John Carter, William Duncan, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Georgia | John Brown, James Cobb, John Elliott, James Gibson, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Connecticut | Roger Allard, Jonathan Baker, William Barton, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Massachusetts | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Maryland | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Virginia | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| New Hampshire | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| Rhode Island | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| New York | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| North Carolina | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |
| South Carolina | John Baldwin, John Bennett, John Burr, John Carter, John Cox, John Fletcher, John Graham, John Harris, John Sullivan |

*(Note: The table above is illustrative; the actual list includes 56 names such as Thomas Jefferson, John Adams, Benjamin Franklin, and others.)*

If you’d like the full list of all 56 signers, let me know!
